sentences.en: STUDENT: Well, my group has been doing a project on how household waste is recycled in Britain.
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 好吧，我们小组一直在做一个关于英国家庭垃圾如何回收利用的项目。

sentences.en: We were quite shocked to discover that only 9% of people here in the UK make an effort to recycle their household waste.
sentences.zh: 我们非常震惊地发现，英国仅有9%的人会主动努力回收自家产生的生活垃圾。

sentences.en: This is a lower figure than in most other European countries, and needs to increase dramatically in the next few years if the government is going to mect its recycling targets.
sentences.zh: 这一比例低于大多数其他欧洲国家；若要实现政府设定的回收目标，未来几年该比例必须大幅提高。

sentences.en: The agreed targets for the UK mean that by 2008 we must reduce our carbon dioxide emissions by 12.5%, compared with 1990.
sentences.zh: 英国已达成一致的目标是：到2008年，二氧化碳排放量须比1990年减少12.5%。

sentences.en: And recycling can help to achieve that goal, in two main ways: the production of recycled glass and paper uses much less energy than producing them from virgin materials, and also recycling reduces greenhouse gas emissions from landfill sites and incineration plants.
sentences.zh: 而回收利用可在两方面助力实现该目标：一是用再生玻璃和再生纸进行生产所消耗的能源，远低于使用原始原材料；二是回收利用可减少垃圾填埋场和焚烧厂所产生的温室气体排放。

sentences.en: As part of our a project, we carried out a survey of people in the street, and the thing that came up over and over again is that people don't think it's easy enough to recycle their waste.
sentences.zh: 作为本项目的一部分，我们在街头对公众进行了问卷调查，结果反复出现的一个问题是：人们普遍认为回收垃圾不够便利。

sentences.en: One problem is that there aren't cnough 'drop- off sites, that is, the places where the public are supposed to take their waste.
sentences.zh: 其中一个问题是‘投放点’数量不足，即公众本应前往投放垃圾的指定地点。

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com 7. 3-18 We also discovered that waste that's collected from householders is taken to places called 'bring banks', for sorting and baling into loads.
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 7. 3-18 我们还发现，从居民处收集来的垃圾会被运往名为‘回收点’（bring banks）的场所，进行分类与打包成捆。

sentences.en: One problem Sage.com here is taking out everything that shouldn't have been placed in the recycling
sentences.zh: 此处存在的一个问题是：需人工挑拣出所有本不该放入回收容器的杂物。

sentences.en: containers: people put all sorts of things into bottle banks, like plastic bags and even broken umbrellas.
sentences.zh: 人们把各种各样的东西都塞进瓶类回收箱，例如塑料袋，甚至破损的雨伞。

sentences.en: All this has to be removed by hand.
sentences.zh: 所有这些杂物都必须由人工逐一清除。

sentences.en: Another difficulty is that toughened glass used for cooking doesn't fully melt at the temperature required for other glass, and so that also has to be picked out by hand.
sentences.zh: 另一个难点在于：用于烹饪的钢化玻璃，在其他玻璃所需的熔融温度下无法完全熔化，因此也必须靠人工挑拣出来。

sentences.en: Glass is easy to recycle because it can be reused over and over again without becoming weaker.
sentences.zh: 玻璃易于回收，因为它可被反复循环使用而不会变脆或强度下降。

sentences.en: Two million tons of glass is thrown away each year, that is, seven billion bottles and jars; but only 500,000 tons of that is collected and recycled.
sentences.zh: 每年有200万吨玻璃被丢弃，相当于70亿个玻璃瓶和玻璃罐；但其中仅有50万吨被收集并成功回收。

sentences.en: Oddly enough, half the glass that's collected is green, and a lot of that is imported, so more green glass is recycled than the UK needs.
sentences.zh: 颇为奇怪的是，所收集玻璃中有一半为绿色玻璃，且其中大量系进口而来，因此绿色玻璃的回收量已超出英国实际所需。

sentences.en: As a result, new uses are being developed for recycled glass, particularly green glass, for example in fibreglass manufacture and water filtration.
sentences.zh: 为此，业界正积极开发再生玻璃（尤其是绿色玻璃）的新用途，例如制造玻璃纤维及水过滤系统。

sentences.en: A company called CLE Aggregates makes a product for roads, and 30% of the material is crushed glass.
sentences.zh: 一家名为CLE Aggregates的公司生产道路建设用材料，其中30%的成分即为破碎玻璃。

sentences.en: For recycling paper, Britain comes second in Europe with 40%, behind Germany's amazing 70%.
sentences.zh: 在纸张回收方面，英国以40%的回收率位居欧洲第二，仅次于德国高达70%的惊人水平。

sentences.en: When recycling started, there were quality problems, so it was difficult to* use recycled paper in office printers.
sentences.zh: 回收利用刚起步时曾存在质量问题，因此再生纸难以用于办公打印机。

sentences.en: But these problems have now been solved, and Martin's, based in South London, produces a range of office stationery which is 100% recycled, costs the same as normal paper and is of equally high quality.
sentences.zh: 但这些问题如今已得到解决；总部位于伦敦南部的Martin公司已推出一系列100%再生办公文具，其价格与普通纸张相同，质量亦同样优异。

sentences.en: But this high quality comes at a cost in terms of the waste produced during the process.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种高品质再生纸的生产过程会产生大量废料，因而成本较高。

sentences.en: Over a third of the waste paper that comes in can't be used in the recycled paper, leaving the question of what to do with it.
sentences.zh: 运抵工厂的废纸中，超过三分之一无法用于再生纸生产，由此引出一个问题：这些废料该如何处置？

sentences.en: One firm, Papersave, currently sells this to farmers as soil conditioner, though this practice will soon be banned because of transport costs and the smell, and the company is looking into the possibility of alternative uses.
sentences.zh: 目前，一家名为Papersave的公司将其出售给农民用作土壤改良剂；但因运输成本高昂且气味难闻，该做法即将被禁止；该公司正在探索其他可行的替代用途。

sentences.en: Plastic causes problems, because there are so many different types of plastic in use today, and each one has to be dealt with differently.
sentences.zh: 塑料回收面临难题，因为当今市面上塑料种类繁多，而每种类型均需采用不同的处理方式。

sentences.en: Pacrite recycles all sorts of things, from bottles to car bumpers, and one of its most successful activities is recycling plastic bottles to make containers which are used all over the country to collect waste.
sentences.zh: Pacrite公司可回收各类物品，从饮料瓶到汽车保险杠皆可；其中最成功的业务之一，便是将塑料瓶回收制成遍布全国的垃圾收集容器。

sentences.en: The Save-a-Cup scheme was set up by the vending and plastics industries to recycle as many as possible of the three-and-a-half billion polystyrene cups used each year.
sentences.zh: ‘Save-a-Cup’计划由自动售货业与塑料行业联合发起，旨在尽可能多地回收每年使用的35亿只聚苯乙烯泡沫杯。

sentences.en: At the moment 500 million polycups are collected, processed and sold on to other businesses, such as Waterford, which turns the cups into pencils, and Johnson & Jones, a Welsh-based firm, which has developed a wide variety of items, including business cards.
sentences.zh: 目前，已有5亿只泡沫杯被收集、加工，并转售给其他企业；例如Waterford公司将其制成铅笔，而总部位于威尔士的Johnson & Jones公司则开发出包括名片在内的多种产品。

sentences.en: Well, to sum up, there seems to be plenty of research going on into how to re-use materials, but the biggest problem is getting people to think about recycling instead of throwing things away.
sentences.zh: 总之，目前针对材料再利用的研究十分丰富，但最大难题在于如何促使人们转变观念——主动考虑回收利用，而非随手丢弃。

sentences.en: At least doing the research made us much more careful.
sentences.zh: 至少，开展这项研究使我们自身变得谨慎得多。
